ValidationRule.description: When “Eligible to include in Carves Allocation” is enabled, values are required in the following fields: Contract Liability Segment, Contract Revenue Segment, Carves Liability Segment and Carves Revenue Segment.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: Ruby__CarvesEligible__c = true && ( Ruby__CarvesLiabilitySegment__c = null || Ruby__CarvesRevenueSegment__c = null || Ruby__ContractLiabilitySegment__c = null || Ruby__ContractRevenueSegment__c = null )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When Eligible to include in Carves Allocation is selected, values are required in the following fields: Contract Liability Segment, Contract Revenue Segment, Carves Liability Segment and Carves Revenue Segment.
